name: null-first
description: null-first: /nulls, plus a toast when a verdict lacks a losing null. Rule 14 (null_first): a PASS counts only when a null ran and lost (flip: null PF < 1.0 and < real PF; random_entry: null_pct >= 95, else null PF < real PF). Watches ~/.claude/verdict/latest.json the way verdict-line does and toasts once per new non-FAIL verdict that fails the rule, whether or not the policy switch is on (the switch in ~/.claude/verdict/policy.json only controls blocking). /nulls [idea] lists the experiment ledger rows with their nulls and the rule result. Rule semantics come from policy.ts, shared byte for byte with verdict-line.
